nodes.description: CErc20Delegator._setImplementation(address,bool,bytes): admin-gated upgrade that delegatecalls into an arbitrary implementation
CErc20Delegator.delegateAndReturn(): delegatecalls implementation with raw msg.data and returns raw returndata
Unitroller payable fallback: delegatecalls comptrollerImplementation with msg.data
CDaiDelegate.doTransferIn: pulls DAI via transferFrom, joins into vat and supplies pie into the DSR pot
CDaiDelegate.doTransferOut: exits pie from the DSR pot and withdraws DAI through daiJoin
CDaiDelegate.accrueInterest: drips the DSR pot then calls super.accrueInterest
CDaiDelegate._becomeImplementation: admin-gated setup that approves, hopes and drips Maker contracts
Cheese.delegateBySig: recovers a signature, checks nonce and expiry, then delegates votes
Cheese._transferTokens: moves balances with bounded 96-bit arithmetic and moves delegates
Cheese._writeCheckpoint: writes vote checkpoints keyed by block number
Comptroller.refreshCompSpeeds: tx.origin gated recomputation of CHEESE distribution speeds
Comptroller.transferComp: performs an external CHEESE token transfer when accrued exceeds threshold
Comptroller.claimComp: claims accrued CHEESE for holders across markets
CToken.accrueInterest: interest accrual using block delta and checked mantissa math
CToken.mintFresh: external transfer-in, exchange rate math and supply/balance updates
CToken.redeemFresh: computes redemption and performs external transfer-out
CToken.borrowFresh: borrow accounting followed by external transfer-out of underlying
CToken.liquidateBorrowFresh: repays a borrow and triggers collateral seizure
CToken.seize: external entry point that trusts msg.sender as the seizing cToken
CToken.seizeInternal: comptroller-approved collateral balance movement
Comptroller.borrowAllowed: liquidity and oracle price checks before borrowing
CErc20.doTransferIn: external transferFrom with assembly handling of non-standard ERC-20 return
CErc20.doTransferOut: external token transfer with assembly returndata validation
CToken._setPendingAdmin: admin-only two-step admin handover
CToken._acceptAdmin: pending admin accepts and becomes admin
CToken._setComptroller: admin-only comptroller replacement validated by marker method
CToken._reduceReservesFresh: admin-only reserve reduction with external transfer-out
Comptroller._supportMarket: admin-only listing of a new cToken market
Comptroller._setMiningBuff: admin or initializing only update of the mining buff multiplier
CarefulMath.mulUInt: multiplication with explicit overflow error code
CarefulMath.addUInt: addition with explicit overflow error code
CarefulMath.subUInt: subtraction with explicit underflow error code
Cheese.transferFrom: allowance consumption and bounded balance movement
CErc20.initialize: sets underlying and validates it via totalSupply() call
